$comment: Which locales this repo translates into, and which of them gate.
`targets` lists every locale this repo translates into. Add a locale in the
same change that adds its content: a listed locale with no files makes every
script process an empty locale. Which further locales are in scope is an open
decision (see CLAUDE.md, 'Open questions'), so do not settle it by editing
this file.
`productionTargets` is the subset held to a production standard, so that
users of these locales never see untranslated text. It is used in two places:
- `scripts/validate.mjs` only exits non-zero on errors in these locales.
Errors in other locales are still found, printed and counted.
- `scripts/completeness.mjs` holds each source repo's PRs to it: a PR that
changes English cannot merge until every locale here has the translation.
An empty list is allowed here (in Jiki's repo it is a fatal error). The
scripts accept it and print a notice on every run, so a run that gates
nothing is not mistaken for a pass. A missing or non-array list, or a locale
that `targets` does not include, is still fatal.
A locale joins `productionTargets` before the website serves it. The
website's own list of served locales (config/application.rb,
`I18n.available_locales`) is separate, and every locale it serves must
already be listed here.
English is not a target locale and never appears in either list. It is not
stored in this repo. See ENGLISH-SOURCE.md.
